_note: Vision review (Claude, 14 Oct 2026) of candidate person links proposed by pipeline/link_persons.py (motion.py map re-links + image gap bridges), from contact sheets with 4 isolated crops of the last 2 s of track A and 4 of the first 2 s of track B (link_persons.py --review-sheet). same = the person at the end of A is the person at the start of B; different = another person or the camera operator; unclear = cannot tell (partial legs, far crowd, or the track itself switches between people).
